tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search for trading cards and sealed products on Cardpeer. Returns one result per product with the cheapest active listing price AND last known market/Cardpeer price. All prices are in euro cents (500 = €5.00).

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Find individual seller listings for a specific product, grouped by seller × condition × price. Use search_cards first to get a product_id.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full details for a single product: card info, set, series, pricing snapshots, and language variants.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Historical pricing snapshots from Cardpeer and the market. Prices in euro cents.

tools.name: list_sets
tools.description: List available card sets/expansions. The slug can be used in search_cards.

tools.name: list_series
tools.description: List available card series (e.g. "Scarlet & Violet"). The slug can be used in search_cards.
